findingDetails.title: A question that leads with `how do` or `how can` still gets the command attached
findingDetails.scopeProof: command-attach.ts and skill_advisor.py are both in reviewScopeFiles; four interrogative shapes probed live in both languages, with what does / how does returning true in the same run
findingDetails.fix: add the first-person interrogative forms (how do / how can / how should / how would) to COMMAND_ASK_NAMED_WORDS so both copies pick them up from one list

results.summary: security framing of REQ-020, REQ-024, REQ-025, REQ-027 and REQ-030 guards confirmed; the full 34-row sweep runs in iterations 3 and 5

noveltyJustification: One new P2 and no prior finding carried into the pass, so every weighted point this iteration counted is new: (1 + 0) / 1. The iteration also settled seven security surfaces clean, which are recorded rather than counted.
